description: NEPTR 4.2 housing outer form (analytic). Plan outline C0 = curvature-spline curve (cubic B-spline curvature, G3), mirrored in x; profile = quintic Bezier (G2 into flat top/bottom), inset d(z) applied as exact parallel offset along C0 normal.

c0.note: half curve from top-centre flat (x 0..x1) heading +x, clockwise to bottom-centre; kappa(s)=cubic B-spline (coefs_full, clamped uniform knots on [0,L]); L solved so phi(L)=-pi exactly; x mirrored for the left half

profile.note: quintic Bezier in (d,z): P0=(D,0) P1=(D-a1,0) P2=(D-a2,0) P3=(0,h-c2) P4=(0,h-c1) P5=(0,h); vertical wall h..62-h; top = mirror z->62-z. d = inward offset of the outline.

fit.note: old SE corner/ear rings recede faster than a parallel offset (plan-section residual up to 7.5 mm at the SE inner rings, 3D normal distance <= 2.3): not reproduced, the new form uses one parallel-offset family for all four corners
